next.tour.lessonsHint: Try it hands-on on the Relay demo projects
next.tour.site.name: Sinopia · site
next.tour.site.sinopia.title: Open Sinopia
next.tour.site.sinopia.text: Sites, decks and videos live here — yours and your team's.
next.tour.site.open.title: Open «Relay — лендинг»
next.tour.site.open.text: A demo project: break it freely, it is yours.
next.tour.site.click.title: Flip the switches
next.tour.site.click.text: Three flags in the code block on the right — they are ringed. Click any: the mockup is live and answers like a real product.
next.tour.site.page.title: Open the «Цены» page
next.tour.site.page.text: Pages of a project open as tabs, like in a browser.
next.tour.site.year.title: Switch to yearly
next.tour.site.year.text: The «Yearly» switch is ringed on the mockup. The prices change — the mockup's logic is real too.
next.tour.site.edit.title: Turn on editing
next.tour.site.edit.text: The chat with the agent docks to the left of the mockup: whatever it changes shows at once.
next.tour.site.device.title: See it on iPhone 14
next.tour.site.device.text: The device button puts the mockup in a phone's size.
next.tour.site.ask.title: Send it to the agent
next.tour.site.ask.text: The note on the heading is in the chat field on the left. Send it — the agent changes the mockup. The lesson picked a fast model.
next.tour.site.outro: You went through the site: a live mockup, an edit by the agent, pages and the phone. The demo stays in your library — experiment.
next.tour.slides.name: Sinopia · slides
next.tour.slides.sinopia.title: Open Sinopia
next.tour.slides.sinopia.text: Decks live in the same library as sites.
next.tour.slides.open.title: Open «Relay — релизы без страха»
next.tour.slides.next.title: Turn a slide
next.tour.slides.next.text: With → or the button under the slide.
next.tour.slides.edit.title: Turn on editing
next.tour.slides.edit.text: The agent edits the deck: the chat docks on the left, the slides on the right, the speaker notes under a slide.
next.tour.slides.comment.title: Leave a comment
next.tour.slides.comment.text: The note sits right on the slide, where your team will see it.
next.tour.slides.show.title: Present the deck
next.tour.slides.show.text: The «Present» button over the slides («Full screen» when viewing): page with the arrows, Esc leaves.
next.tour.slides.ask.title: Ask the agent
next.tour.slides.ask.text: The request is in the chat field on the left — send it and the slide comes into the deck. The lesson picked a fast model.
next.tour.slides.outro: Deck done. Relay's deck stays with you — edit and present it.
next.tour.video.name: Sinopia · video
next.tour.video.sinopia.title: Open Sinopia
next.tour.video.sinopia.text: Videos are made of scenes, like decks of slides.
next.tour.video.open.title: Open «Relay за 30 секунд»
next.tour.video.play.title: Play the video
next.tour.video.scene.title: Go to the next scene
next.tour.video.scene.text: The «next scene» button or a mark on the timeline.
next.tour.video.timeline.title: Scrub the timeline
next.tour.video.timeline.text: Drag it — the animation follows frame by frame.
next.tour.video.ask.title: Ask the agent
next.tour.video.ask.text: Turn on «Edit» if the chat is not there: the request is in the field — send it and the scene changes. The lesson picked a fast model.
next.tour.video.download.title: Download the video
next.tour.video.download.text: MP4 renders right on the machine; a scene can be downloaded alone.
next.tour.video.outro: Video done. Try changing the scenes' texts or length.
next.tour.ds.name: Sinopia · design system
next.tour.ds.sinopia.title: Open Sinopia
next.tour.ds.sinopia.text: A design system holds the colors, fonts and components of every mockup.
next.tour.ds.open.title: Open «Дизайн-система Relay»
next.tour.ds.open.text: Relay's site, deck and video are built on it.
next.tour.ds.look.title: Look inside
next.tour.ds.look.text: Palette, fonts, buttons and cards — one source of truth.
next.tour.ds.back.title: Back to the library
next.tour.ds.back.text: Let's make a new mockup in this style.
next.tour.ds.pick.title: Pick the Relay system
next.tour.ds.make.title: Build a page
next.tour.ds.make.text: The request is in the field — send it and the page comes out in Relay's style. The lesson picked a fast model.
next.tour.ds.outro: Done: a new page built on your design system.
next.tour.welcome.name: Introduction
next.tour.welcome.field.title: Write the task in words
next.tour.welcome.field.text: The agent works on your machine: reads code, runs commands and shows what it did.
next.tour.welcome.plus.title: Files, screenshots, designs
next.tour.welcome.plus.text: «+» attaches a file, a photo, a Sinopia design or a task from the tracker.
next.tour.welcome.model.title: Agent and model
next.tour.welcome.model.text: Claude or Codex, the model and the depth of thinking — per chat.
next.tour.welcome.list.title: Every chat and its status
next.tour.welcome.list.text: The chat's icon tells you: thinking, waiting for an answer, asking permission or done.
next.tour.welcome.pane.title: The right pane
next.tour.welcome.pane.text: Browser, terminal, files and changes — beside the chat.
next.tour.welcome.sinopia.title: Sinopia
next.tour.welcome.sinopia.text: Sites, decks, videos and design systems. The Relay demo projects are already there — try them.
next.tour.welcome.learn.title: Lessons — under «More»
next.tour.welcome.learn.text: «More» → «Learn»: ten short lessons, each one done by hand.
next.tour.welcome.outro: You know the basics. Next — lessons on the chat, the pane, Sinopia and the safe.
next.tour.chat.name: First chat
next.tour.chat.home.title: Open a new chat
next.tour.chat.home.text: Each chat is an agent of its own with its own task.
next.tour.chat.type.title: Write a task
next.tour.chat.type.text: In plain words, as to a colleague: what to do and where. Say: «Tell me what this folder holds».
next.tour.chat.plus.title: Open «+»
next.tour.chat.plus.text: It attaches a file, a screenshot, a Sinopia design or a tracker task.
next.tour.chat.model.title: Open the model picker
next.tour.chat.model.text: Hard work — a stronger model and more depth; quick work — a lighter one.
next.tour.chat.mic.title: Voice works too
next.tour.chat.mic.text: Press the microphone and speak — the text appears in the field. No microphone? Just press «Done».
next.tour.chat.send.title: Send it
next.tour.chat.send.text: Enter or the arrow — and the agent gets to work.
next.tour.chat.turn.title: Open the agent's turn
next.tour.chat.turn.text: The turn is folded into one line: commands, files read and edits inside.
next.tour.chat.outro: You gave the agent a task. Next — working while it thinks.
next.tour.work.name: While the agent works
next.tour.work.send.title: Give the agent a task
next.tour.work.send.text: Something for a minute or two: «Go through the project and describe its structure».
next.tour.work.list.title: The status — in the list
next.tour.work.list.text: A spinning icon — thinking. A question, a shield or a check say it waits for you or is done.
next.tour.work.turn.title: Open the turn
next.tour.work.turn.text: See what the agent is doing right now: commands, files, edits.
next.tour.work.queue.title: Write without waiting
next.tour.work.queue.text: Send one more message — it joins the queue above the field.
next.tour.work.next.title: The agent takes it itself
next.tour.work.next.text: Done with one, it answers the queue. Nothing to repeat.
next.tour.work.outro: The agent works and you go on. Next — the right pane.
next.tour.pane.name: The right pane
next.tour.pane.open.title: Open the pane
next.tour.pane.open.text: The tools of this chat and the machine — beside the conversation.
next.tour.pane.tools.title: Tools — as tabs
next.tour.pane.tools.text: A browser for the dev server or a stand, files, changes. The agent opens here what it made.
next.tour.pane.term.title: Open the terminal
next.tour.pane.term.text: The commands the agent sees. You can step in by hand.
next.tour.pane.outro: The pane is your desk beside the agent.
next.tour.safe.name: Safe and connections
next.tour.safe.settings.title: Open the settings
next.tour.safe.settings.text: Press your name at the bottom left.
next.tour.safe.safe.title: Open «Safe»
next.tour.safe.safe.text: Keys and tokens stay on your machine. The agent takes them by name and never sees the values.
next.tour.safe.conn.title: Open «Connections»
next.tour.safe.conn.text: Tracker, wiki, GitLab and MCP servers — the agent reads them itself, no tokens in the chat.
next.tour.safe.outro: Secrets go to the safe, services to connections. Nothing to paste into the chat.
next.tour.agents.name: Several agents
next.tour.agents.home.title: Open one more chat
next.tour.agents.home.text: One more chat — one more agent. They run in parallel and don't get in each other's way.
next.tour.agents.list.title: The status — an icon
next.tour.agents.list.text: The list shows who thinks, who waits for you and who is done.
next.tour.agents.subs.title: Open «Subagents»
next.tour.agents.subs.text: Open the pane and pick «Subagents»: it shows the parts the agent split the task into.
next.tour.agents.outro: Several tasks — several chats. No waiting.
next.tour.extra.name: Small comforts
next.tour.extra.search.title: Open search
next.tour.extra.bell.title: Open notifications
next.tour.extra.bell.text: Here when the agent is done or waits for you. Telegram is connected in the settings.
next.tour.extra.side.title: The side chat — in the pane
next.tour.extra.side.text: Ask about the work in the side chat — the main agent isn't distracted.
next.tour.extra.outro: That's all. The lessons can be done again under «More» → «Learn».
next.tour.pane.chat.title: Open a chat
next.tour.pane.chat.text: Any in the list, or a new one — send a task. The pane and the terminal live beside the conversation.
next.tour.agents.send.title: Send a task
next.tour.agents.send.text: A new agent takes it while the other chats do their own.
next.tour.loading: The mockup is loading — a couple of seconds.
next.tour.away: The next step is «{step}». It is not on this page: go back, the lesson goes on from the same place.
next.tour.site.pick.title: Press «Pick»
next.tour.site.pick.text: This is how you show the agent which block to change: the button is ringed in the bar over the mockup.
next.tour.site.heading.title: Click the heading
next.tour.site.heading.text: The big heading is ringed on the mockup. A click opens a note for it.
next.tour.site.note.title: Write what to change
next.tour.site.note.text: The note is already filled in — change it if you like and press the arrow: the note goes into the message to the agent.
next.tour.site.note.needs: Pick a block first: the note is written for it.
next.tour.site.ask.needs: Pick the heading and write a note for it first — without one the agent has nothing to change.
